news.title: Live news reaches the islands
news.text: A message in a bottle washed up at dawn. From now on the islands hear fresh news every day. Listen to what people say about it.

events.title: Good news lifts spirits
events.text: Everyone is talking about the bottle. People feel a little brighter today.

events.title: A story to remember
events.text: The bottle had a drawing of seven lights inside.

effect.text: a bottle with seven lights drawn inside

story.text: Bottles never come by chance. Someone out there wants us to keep the lights burning.

news.title: Shoals near the reef
news.text: Gulls are diving all morning near the reef. Fishers say it is a good day for the rod.

events.title: Fish are biting
events.text: Big shoals swim close to the shore for a while.

news.title: The crew wants a lookout
news.text: The work crew says a lookout would help everyone see storms coming.

events.title: Plans for a lookout
events.text: The crew sketches a tall lookout on a flat rock.

effect.idea: A lookout to watch for storms

events.title: Proud crew
events.text: Your crew is proud of their work and hums while they build.

story.text: If we can see the storm, we can beat the storm.

news.title: Clouds in the west
news.text: The sky turns grey in the west. Keep some wood dry and check your shelter.

events.title: Worried faces
events.text: People keep looking at the western sky.
